description: This file provides a SOCKS v5 client implementation, including command, address, connection, and dialer types, as well as authentication methods and protocol constants.

classes.name: Addr
classes.description: Represents a SOCKS-specific address with either a hostname or IP and a port.

classes.name: Conn
classes.description: Represents a SOCKS forward proxy connection, embedding net.Conn and including bound address info.

classes.name: Dialer
classes.description: Holds SOCKS-specific options for establishing connections, including command type, proxy info, and authentication.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of Command.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of Reply.

methods.name: Network
methods.description: Returns the network type for Addr ('socks').

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of Addr, combining IP or Name with Port.

methods.name: BoundAddr
methods.description: Returns the address assigned by the proxy server for the connection.

methods.name: DialContext
methods.description: Establishes a SOCKS connection to a specified address with context support.

methods.name: DialWithConn
methods.description: Uses an existing connection to initiate a SOCKS connection to a target address.

methods.name: Dial
methods.description: Deprecated method to establish a raw connection to a target address.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates network and command type for the dialer.

methods.name: pathAddrs
methods.description: Parses and returns proxy and destination addresses from strings.

methods.name: NewDialer
methods.description: Creates a new SOCKS dialer with specified network and address.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Performs username/password authentication with the proxy server.
